security_audit.summary: All 96 static findings are false positives caused by Markdown syntax, disclosed links, token-storage documentation, or ordinary prose. Two contextual risks remain: mutable CLI installation and intentional data transfer to a paid third-party API.

remediation.issue: The RunComfy CLI install and npx examples do not pin a reviewed version.
remediation.suggestion: Pin an audited package version and publish integrity or provenance checks for installation.

remediation.issue: Music requests send user inputs to a metered third-party service.
remediation.suggestion: Confirm the data scope and estimated charge before submitting sensitive or costly requests.

content.user_title: Create and Edit Music with ACE Step
content.value_statement: Music generation and repair can require separate tools and costly services. This skill routes generation, inpainting, and outpainting through ACE Step on RunComfy.
actual_capabilities: Routes new-track requests to ACE Step base or ACE Step 1.5.
Generates 5-to-240-second stereo music from tags, lyrics, duration, and seed.
Creates multilingual structured vocal songs through ACE Step 1.5.
Regenerates selected time ranges in source audio through inpainting.
Extends source audio before, after, or both through outpainting.
Downloads generated audio to the selected local output directory.
limitations: Requires the RunComfy CLI, authentication, network access, and paid model API access.
Each generation or extension is limited to 240 seconds per call.
Inpainting and outpainting require a reachable HTTPS source audio URL.
The included documentation cannot verify the external CLI service behavior.

use_cases.title: Repair a recorded section
use_cases.description: Regenerate a defined chorus or bridge while steering the replacement with matching style tags.

use_cases.title: Build game music drafts
use_cases.description: Generate repeatable instrumental loops with tempo, mood, instruments, duration, and fixed seeds.

use_cases.title: Localize a campaign song
use_cases.description: Reuse one musical direction with structured lyrics written in several supported languages.

prompt_templates.title: Generate an instrumental
prompt_templates.prompt: Generate a 60-second instrumental with ACE Step. Use lo-fi hip-hop, Rhodes piano, soft drums, 75 BPM, and no vocals.

prompt_templates.title: Create structured vocals
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a 90-second Japanese pop song with ACE Step 1.5. Use Verse, Chorus, Bridge, and Outro sections with a fixed seed.

prompt_templates.title: Repair a track section
prompt_templates.prompt: Replace seconds 20 through 40 of {audio_url}. Match the indie-pop style, use piano without drums, and save the result.

prompt_templates.title: Extend both ends
prompt_templates.prompt: Extend {audio_url} by 30 seconds before and 60 after. Preserve tempo, build the intro, fade the outro, and use seed 42.
prompt_templates.scenario: Create a longer arrangement from a short hook.

output_examples.input: Generate a 60-second lo-fi instrumental with Rhodes piano and no vocals.
output_examples.output: A 60-second stereo lo-fi track is generated and saved in the selected output directory.

output_examples.input: Replace seconds 20 through 40 of an indie-pop track with a piano bridge.
output_examples.output: The selected segment is regenerated with matching tags while the request keeps the surrounding track as context.

output_examples.input: Add a 30-second intro and a 60-second outro to a short hook.
output_examples.output: The source receives both extensions in one outpainting request, then the result is downloaded.

best_practices: Use specific tags for genre, mood, instruments, vocals, and BPM.
Fix the seed for repeatable iterations, and use minus one for exploration.
Confirm usage rights and accept only source URLs explicitly provided for the task.
anti_patterns: Do not place the RunComfy token in prompts, logs, or versioned files.
Do not submit unreviewed third-party audio URLs.
Do not request durations or edit ranges beyond endpoint limits.

faq.question: What does this skill require?
faq.answer: It requires the RunComfy CLI, a RunComfy token, network access, and available account credit.

faq.question: Which endpoint should I use?
faq.answer: Use base for drafts, 1.5 for multilingual vocals, inpaint for repairs, and outpaint for extensions.

faq.question: How long can generated audio be?
faq.answer: Generation supports 5 to 240 seconds per call. Longer workflows require carefully chained calls.

faq.question: Does it support multilingual lyrics?
faq.answer: ACE Step 1.5 claims support for lyrics in more than 50 languages.

faq.question: How do audio edits receive source files?
faq.answer: Inpainting and outpainting require a reachable HTTPS URL for an MP3, WAV, or FLAC source.

faq.question: Can results be reproduced?
faq.answer: Use a fixed seed for repeatable requests. Service updates may still change output behavior.
